verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents campaign creation via API and MCP prompts like "Create an email campaign," along with drag-and-drop email editors and segmentation for audience building. Its Composer feature claims to build the audience, draft the content, and map out the send strategy. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the send-now/schedule step and audience selection on a campaign, independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end loop.
